name: Adobe Creative Production API
description: Creative Production batch automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io): a CreativeProductionPort + adapter that maps a published workflow over N assets in one async batch job and surfaces per-asset status (partial success) over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async batch.
checklist: Confirm the Creative Production API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)

Verify the current host/endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — the Creative Production API is configured via ADOBE_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION_BASE_URL (defaults to the image.adobe.io host family; the client posts absolute URLs there)
Provide a published workflow id plus a presigned input + output href per asset — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
runWorkflow returns one per-asset result (status + output href) in request order; a failed asset is reported in-band rather than failing the whole batch
Soft dependency: persist the per-asset batch status in your own store (e.g. supabase/DB) for long-running batches — the adapter returns the breakdown but does not persist it
Pairs naturally with adobe-express for localized variant production
